description: KAL-007, Glasnost and Ortega ordered prefixes with typed restricted operation grants; all runtime handlers remain planned.
inputs: Source-root identity, accepted prefix receipt, exact current continuation and scoped restriction evidence
outputs: Read-only ordered prefixes, restricted grants and shared operation request contracts
preconditions: verified-subset data, not implemented game handlers
Independent source/root/active-event evidence precedes mutation; proof IDs are synthetic in the finite model

Unverified baseline stops only Influence; unbound Chernobyl gates OPS Influence
Unknown relevant operation provider: preserve accepted prefix and require ruling

rule_sources.description: English PDF p13 #89 and p14 #90/#91; no use of adjacent translation.
Sections 5.2,6.0,7.4.1-3,8.1,8.2.5,10.3: source, actor OPS, nuclear and VP checkpoints, free-coup credit.

PDF p15 #90: Glasnost obeys ordinary influence rules and Chernobyl. PDF p16 #94: direct event influence differs from OPS placement; #96: named regional action geographical waiver does not waive battleground DEFCON/free-coup credit.

Ordered accepted prefix then optional decision; source-bound receipts and explicit shared-service handoff. Ortega named adjacency geographic waiver is a scoped derivation of the FAQ regional-action policy, not a dedicated Ortega ruling. No production operation resolution.
